correctness.rationale: A new interval [u,v] meets precisely the intersection of the suffix r_i≥u and prefix l_i≤v. To realize an interior block [i,j] one needs r_(i−1)<u<v<l_(j+1), along with u≤r_i and v≥l_j. Necessity of the flank bounds follows from hitting i and j and monotonicity; if the flanks are disjoint, take u strictly between r_(i−1) and min(r_i,l_(j+1)), and then v strictly between max(u,l_j) and l_(j+1). This proves sufficiency with a positive-length witness; a free end handles a boundary block, and a distant interval realizes the empty type. The absent blocks are in bijection with edges (a,b) spanning at least two index steps, with exponent b−a−1. An absent consecutive edge partitions the entire graph across that cut, so the consecutive edges form a spanning path in each component and number m−c. The defect is therefore e−m+c, and zero defect means exactly that the consecutive paths are all the edges. This last argument proves the equality case without a claw-free or chordality lemma. The singleton base is covered, and the extension count excludes equalities to named vertices; no re-representation or propriety of the enlarged graph is required.
residual_risks: The independent replay verifies exact labelled sets and grading only on the stated finite range. The bundled grid includes point witnesses; with distinct base endpoints, a point can be thickened toward the interior of the only interval that might have an endpoint there, avoiding all other endpoint changes, so this does not create spurious profiles. The universal quantifiers are supplied by the endpoint proof, not these grids.

evidence: Bousquet et al. bound closed-neighborhood VC dimension by two for interval graphs, giving the all-block upper bound by Sauer's lemma. Foucaud et al. derive quadratic identifying-code and related bounds from partitions of endpoint positions.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither result determines which subsets of a fixed proper base are absent, nor the degree of each missing pattern. A sharp maximum over host graphs does not recover dependence on the base's edge set.

value.rationale: This refines a motivated trace bound from an extremal number into an exact obstruction for each labelled candidate block. For a fixed base it gives both the realizable types of each cardinality and a graph-intrinsic obstruction to saturation, and resolves all equality cases within the proper-base family. The cycle-space defect captures information the general VC dimension and the extremal count lose.
residual_risks: Value attaches to fixed proper base intervals and unrestricted new witnesses, not to bounded positive quantifier rank or to proper extensions.
